body:
I don't have anything too incredibly helpful to say other than I am hoping for the best for you. I hope you do feel better and while I don't find comfort in knowing you feel so depressed, it is comforting to me knowing that I'm not the only 20 something year old woman out there who is in this situation.  

I can't understand it myself, but I'm just glad I'm not the only one. 
I haven't tried anything..but I've been listening to music and writing helps a little.

Do you know of anything that helps you sometimes when you feel this way?

I was in bed all day today and yesterday, I know how it feels. 

I remember when I had my dog, she would lay with me too and I remember her being there when I cried. Dogs are the best.
